description: This PHP source file defines the OA_Dal_Statistics_Publisher class, which extends OA_Dal_Statistics. It provides methods to retrieve various statistics related to publishers, such as daily, hourly, zone, advertiser, campaign, and banner statistics, from the database. The class constructs SQL queries to gather aggregated data for reporting purposes.

classes.name: OA_Dal_Statistics_Publisher
classes.description: A data abstraction layer class for retrieving publisher-related statistics from the database.

methods.name: getPublisherDailyStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves daily statistics for a specific publisher within a date range, broken down by day and hour.

methods.name: getPublisherHourlyStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves hourly statistics for a specific publisher within a date range, broken down by day and hour.

methods.name: getPublisherZoneStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves statistics broken down by zone for a specific publisher within a date range.

methods.name: getPublisherAdvertiserStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves statistics broken down by advertiser for a specific publisher within a date range.

methods.name: getPublisherCampaignStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves statistics broken down by campaign for a specific publisher within a date range.

methods.name: getPublisherBannerStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves statistics broken down by banner for a specific publisher within a date range.
